title: Evolvable imaging master-protocol research platform
purpose: Stress modular Study Design, versioning and cross-document propagation using admitted current knowledge only, without requiring protected platform-trial content.
initialUserIntent: We want a long-lived multicenter imaging research platform in cardiomyopathy. A common core protocol and data model should support several imaging substudies. New biomarker or imaging modules may be added or stopped over time without rewriting the entire project.

knownFacts.statement: A long-lived multicenter imaging research platform in cardiomyopathy is intended.
A common core protocol is intended to support several imaging substudies.
A common data model is intended to support several imaging substudies.
Biomarker or imaging modules may be added or stopped over time without rewriting the entire project.

unresolvedDecisions.statement: Master-protocol architecture and boundary between common core and substudies.
Governance and human adoption rules for adding, changing, stopping or superseding modules.
Shared population, objectives, endpoints and imaging/data elements versus module-specific elements.
Scientific and operational criteria for module initiation or discontinuation.
Document family and detail allocation for the core platform and modules.

outOfScopeInformation: Protected platform-trial content is not available to runtime and is not required.
No exact platform governance, biomarker list, module schema or stopping rule is supplied.
No final DMP, SAP, Imaging Charter or CRF is required by this optional fixture.
allowedClarifications: Clarify which scientific and operational elements must remain common across modules.
Clarify module lifecycle, adoption, supersession and discontinuation governance.
Clarify shared versus module-specific populations, measurements and data elements.
Clarify versioning, document binding and propagation expectations.
Clarify the first module only if needed to make the platform structure concrete.

conditionalOwners.condition: Only if the adopted platform/module facts create a material regulatory applicability question.

terminalTarget: An optional coherent versioned platform Project model with explicit common/module boundaries and reachable current document projections, without dependence on protected platform content.
